run.command: v="{gf_paper_year_env}"; if [ "$v" != 0 ]; then gf_pip() { if [ -n "$GF_PIP" ]; then $GF_PIP "$@"; else "${PYTHON:-python}" -m pip "$@"; fi; }; [ "$v" = 1 ] && v=all; r="${GF_PY_ROOT:-/opt/gf_py}"; [ "$v" = all ] && v="$(ls "$r" 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" ",")"; GF_LIB_DIRS=""; for p in $(echo "$v" | tr "," " "); do case "$p" in *==*) d="${GF_PY_REL:-/tmp/gf_py}/$p"; case "$p" in torch==*|torchvision==*|torchaudio==*) ix="--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu";; *) ix="";; esac; [ -d "$d" ] || PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 gf_pip install -q --no-deps $ix --target "$d" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "GF_LIB_INSTALL_FAIL $p" >&2;; *) d="$r/$p";; esac; GF_LIB_DIRS="${GF_LIB_DIRS:+$GF_LIB_DIRS|}$d"; done; export GF_LIB_DIRS; fi; mkdir -p out; rm -f out/run*.log; export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1; GF_SEED=$("${PYTHON:-python}" -c "import os, zlib; print(zlib.crc32(os.environ.get('RUN_TAG', 'x').encode('utf-8')) % 100000)"); n=0; for r in $(seq 1 3); do (timeout ${GF_TIME_CUT:-0} "${GF_BASH:-bash}" -c '"${PYTHON:-python}" pubmed-original_transductive_FastGCN.py --dataset cora --model {model} --learning_rate {learning_rate} --epochs {epochs} --hidden1 {hidden1} --dropout {dropout} --weight_decay {weight_decay} --early_stopping {early_stopping} --max_degree {max_degree}') > out/run$r.log 2>&1 & n=$((n+1)); if [ $((n % 3)) -eq 0 ]; then wait; fi; done; wait; "${PYTHON:-python}" gf_harness/emit.py
